config.guardian.scan_desc: Basic settings for the local prompt-injection scan.
config.guardian.preset_help: Strict catches more attacks; Lenient allows more legitimate input through.
config.guardian.max_scan_bytes_help: The size of one scan window. Larger inputs are checked in overlapping windows.
config.guardian.scan_edge_bytes_help: Overlap between adjacent scan windows. 0 uses the default; the middle of the text is checked too.
config.guardian.sanitizer_desc: Cleans input before scanning: Unicode normalization, homoglyph replacement and decoding of obfuscated payloads.
config.guardian.sanitizer_normalize_help: Unifies compatible Unicode forms so visually or technically altered instructions can be detected reliably.
config.guardian.sanitizer_dehomoglyph_he: Replaces look-alike characters from other alphabets that can be used to evade security patterns.
config.guardian.sanitizer_decode_help: Decodes supported obfuscated text forms before scanning so hidden instructions become visible.
config.guardian.embedding_desc: Compares input locally via cosine similarity against known attack vectors. No external model required.
config.guardian.embedding_enabled_help: Adds local similarity matching to the rule-based checks so altered versions of known attack patterns can also be detected.
config.guardian.embedding_threshold_help: 0.0 = report everything, 1.0 = only near-identical attacks. Default: 0.65.
config.guardian.policy_desc: Blocks task pivots based on application context (e.g. translations in a RAG bot).
config.guardian.policy_help: Selects the allowed task context. Instructions that pivot from this context into a blocked task type are treated as suspicious.
config.guardian.custom_policy_help: Select the tasks the custom policy should block.
config.guardian.taint_desc: Marks data provenance (e.g. user, web, tool output) with trust levels.
config.guardian.taint_enabled_help: Marks external and user-provided content with a trust level so downstream protection checks can account for its origin.
config.guardian.taint_level_help: Sets the initial level for content without more specific provenance. Untrusted is the safest default.
config.guardian.llm_judge_desc: Escalates uncertain or policy-sensitive input to the LLM Guardian for deeper review.
config.guardian.llm_judge_enabled_help: Allows an additional semantic review by the configured Guardian LLM when the selected escalation mode applies.
config.guardian.llm_judge_mode_help: Determines which local scan results are sent to the Guardian LLM. Every Input increases protection, cost, and latency.
config.guardian.llm_judge_mode_no_threat: Only When Local Guards Find Nothing
config.guardian.llm_judge_timeout_help: Maximum wait for the judge decision. On timeout, the fail-safe behavior configured for LLM Guardian applies.
config.guardian.llm_judge_policy_help: Additional policy text passed to the judge LLM.
config.guardian.output_desc: Optional preprocessing of the latest user message. Tool outputs retain their separate isolation and checks.
config.guardian.use_sanitized_output_hel: Replaces only the latest user message with its complete normalized and decoded form. Tool outputs retain their own protection processing.
config.guardian.local_title: Local protection for web and email
config.guardian.local_desc: Checks web content and email locally for prompt injection. Optional, with no external model calls.
config.guardian.local_enable_help: Download the model first. After verification, enable it and save the configuration.
config.guardian.local_action: When the model detects a threat
config.guardian.local_datamark_help: Datamarking labels suspicious text but still passes it to the LLM. Hard blocks remain; failed checks withhold the content.
config.guardian.local_failed: The action failed. Check the status and try again.
